title: Build the daily conversation command entry

mainline.contradiction: Workbench has durable tasks, bounded execution, and supervised Mission input, but no text-first duplex coordinator entry that can turn ongoing Principal messages into visible multi-project work without creating a second authority system.
acceptance: A browser conversation entry can create a new local task, apply a requirement correction to the same active obligation, and expose attributable progress and settled output without requiring the Principal to use CLI forms.

The local coordinator runs through an explicit DeepSeek Pro reasoning=max policy whose requested and observed execution identity is retained; unavailable or incompatible provider behavior is visible rather than silently downgraded.

The coordinator remains the single synthesis owner and can form temporary evidence, execution, or review contributors through the worker catalog only when the contribution earns its coordination cost; no standing committee, voting gate, or duplicate task source is introduced.

A text-first bidirectional command/event contract accepts Principal input while output or work is in flight, distinguishes provisional deltas from durable task state, supports explicit interruption, and reconstructs after connection loss from Workbench-owned state rather than provider session memory.

Runtime and UI are separately testable, then one representative multi-project daily-use walkthrough proves task publication, requirement update, visible ongoing work, intervention, and final result through the browser entry.

branches.purpose: Convert the completed repository, Realtime, and coordinator-team investigations into one source-linked candidate architecture; keep research, design, design review, implementation planning, production, and verification under separate contribution owners.
branches.returnCondition: A durable candidate design states source and authority ownership, the text-first duplex contract, coordinator and temporary-team boundary, DeepSeek Pro max policy, staged vertical slices, and disconfirming observations; a fresh non-producing reviewer either clears it or returns exact findings before implementation planning starts.
